stages.label: Set
stages.title: Do the set.
stages.caption: Complete your push-ups. Actual movement footage is still to be recorded.

stages.label: Enter
stages.title: Enter your count.
stages.caption: Enter the reps yourself. The current manual-entry capture is still needed.

stages.label: Save
stages.title: Keep the record.
stages.caption: Save a self-reported set on your phone. The successful-save capture is still needed.

stages.label: Review
stages.title: Come back to it.
stages.caption: Review your saved sets on the same phone. Current history and personal-best captures are still needed.
